svg.title: From Vendor Authorization to Collected Renewal
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-authorized-resale-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From Vendor Authorization to Collected Renewal; subtitle: Five operating stages for license resale and implementation delivery.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The scorecard uses gross license resale and service billings, with vendor costs included in margin. Customer cloud consumption outside the reseller contract is excluded. For actual reporting, assess principal-versus-agent treatment separately; a commission-only arrangement cannot inherit gross resale revenue merely because the reseller helped arrange the purchase.; caption: Maintain one linked evidence trail across vendor authorization, registered opportunity, customer order, entitlement delivery, vendor settlement, and renewal ownership.; stages: label: Authorize; value: Document program rights before offering licenses; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Confirm vendor territory, products, customer eligibility, deal-registration rules, and resale rights. Distinguish AWS Marketplace CPPO selling authorization from Microsoft CSP direct-bill or indirect-reseller responsibilities.; label: Qualify; value: Validate buyer authority and renewal timing; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Use Salesforce or HubSpot to record the procurement owner, incumbent contract, renewal date, seat inventory, budget evidence, and competitive channel position.; label: Quote; value: Lock vendor economics and implementation scope; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Generate a versioned quote from current vendor pricing; separate license charges, deployment fees, marketplace charges, payment dates, and change-order rates.; label: Deliver; value: Reconcile purchased licenses against accepted delivery; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Verify customer tenant identifiers, assign entitlements, complete the implementation checklist, and capture acceptance without retaining unnecessary privileged access.; label: Collect and renew; value: Match settlements and activate renewal alerts; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile customer receipts, marketplace remittances, vendor invoices, and credits. Schedule 120-, 90-, and 60-day renewal alerts with named account ownership.
